_doc: Model and effort routing. Skills and worker.mjs read this file; change models here, not in skills. Aliases resolve through ~/.claude/mithtech-kit.local.json modelRemap (written by install --doctor). Verified 2026-11-08 against code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config.

fable.note: Most capable; for work larger than one sitting. Not a default; may bill to usage credits. Used only as the last escalation step or when the local config sets allowFable.

routes.work: File search, cleanup, status lines, index refresh
Spec intake, G0 reuse check, docs, boilerplate
Orchestrator, wireframes, simple fixes, Next.js/JS sites
Marketing channel plans, copy, content briefs, social, SEO, PR, events planning
Marketing strategy and budget split, paid ads, partner terms, event/ATL spend cases, KPI and tracking design
Frappe features (Custom Fields, hooks, controllers, reports), Medusa features, tests, checker
Rust features, Medusa workflows with compensation, integrations, risky small changes
Unfamiliar stacks (Go, Flutter, TDL, others): docs lookup first
G1 architecture, contracts, data model, migrations
Accounting/ledgers, multi-company, payments, tenancy/security, offline sync, merge conflicts
Hard bugs after escalation fails; final review of a large program

floors.when: money, permissions, production data or shared contracts

policy: Every session or subagent you start (start_session, Agent, worker.mjs) gets an explicit model and effort from these routes. Never let it inherit the parent's setting.
Pick the cheapest setting likely to succeed the first time; a retry costs more than one step up.
The orchestrator may move one step up or down for a task, with a one-line reason in the routing log.
Stop rule: retry once at the same setting, then escalate one step (effort first, then model), then park as a question.
